content.text: In Nigeria, creators face significant challenges in receiving payments for their [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/digital-product-payment-solutions-west-africa-my-unfiltered|Digital Product]] products due to restrictions on platforms like Stripe and PayPal. This [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-solana-payments-digital-products-stripe-4|COREMERCH guide to infrastructure]]-guide-github-pages-free-digital-product|infrastructure]] gap can be bridged with NOWPayments, enabling creators to receive crypto payments without relying on conventional platforms. This guide will walk you through setting up a NOWPayments digital store, allowing you to deploy a sovereign commerce stack today.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: Setting Up a NOWPayments Digital Store: The Full Guide at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-setting-up-nowpayments-digital-store-works-how-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: Setting Up a NOWPayments Digital Store: The Full Guide

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The NOWPayments infrastructure works by utilizing a combination of free and paid tools, providing a complete digital commerce stack. This stack includes hosting on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, backend logic with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and order storage with Supabase or Google Sheets. By leveraging these tools, creators can own their infrastructure, eliminating dependencies on restrictive platforms like Stripe and Gumroad.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Converting crypto to local currency is the operational step that determines whether crypto payments are practically useful for a creator in a restricted market. In Nigeria, the most established route is USDT to naira through Binance P2P or local exchanges including Patricia and Quidax. Rates are consistently within 2 to 5 percent of the parallel market rate. In Ghana, cedis conversion happens through Binance P2P and active local P2P communities. In Kenya, USDT to Kenyan shilling is available through M-Pesa integrations on several exchanges. Average conversion time across all these markets is 20 to 30 minutes.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment pipeline, you'll need to integrate NOWPayments with your digital store. This involves configuring the payment gateway, setting up webhooks for automatic payment verification, and testing your payment flow. For delivery, you can use Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 to store and distribute your digital products. By streamlining your payment and delivery pipeline, you can ensure a seamless experience for your customers.
NOWPayments offers a 0.5% fee structure, making it a cost-effective option for creators.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is set up, you can go live and start processing transactions. NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, including USDT on Tron and Solana, which offer low transaction fees. With USDT on Tron costing under $0.10 per transaction, you can minimize your costs and maximize your earnings. As you process your first transaction, you'll see the power of your sovereign commerce stack in action.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

As your digital store grows, you'll need to scale your infrastructure to meet increasing demand. This involves optimizing your hosting, backend logic, and order storage to handle higher volumes of traffic and sales. With the Complete Builder Kit ($197), you'll have access to all the blueprints and templates you need to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack. By scaling your infrastructure, you can continue to grow your business without relying on restrictive platforms.
How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?

To receive crypto payments for your digital products, you can use NOWPayments, which offers a 0.5% fee structure and supports over 300 cryptocurrencies. With NOWPayments, you can set up a payment pipeline that automatically verifies transactions and delivers products to customers. This eliminates the need for conventional platforms like Stripe and PayPal, giving you full control over your infrastructure and earnings.
USDT on Tron costs under $0.10 per transaction, minimizing costs and maximizing earnings.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking for a comprehensive solution to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. This kit includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates you need to get started, providing a valuable resource for creators in Nigeria, Ghana, and other regions where conventional platforms are restricted.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your NOWPayments digital store, follow these steps: set up your NOWPayments account and configure your payment settings, choose a hosting platform and set up your domain, integrate NOWPayments with your digital store and configure webhooks, test your payment flow and delivery pipeline, and go live with your sovereign commerce stack. With these steps completed, you can start processing transactions and growing your business without relying on restrictive platforms.

You can convert Bitcoin to naira using a P2P exchange like Binance or Patricia, which offer competitive rates and low fees.

The transaction fee for USDT on Solana averages fractions of a cent per transaction, making it a cost-effective option for creators.

You can set up a webhook with NOWPayments by configuring your payment settings and integrating with your digital store, enabling automatic payment verification and product delivery.

Yes, NOWPayments supports payments in Ghana and other regions where conventional platforms are restricted, providing a valuable solution for creators.
